node: Virtual K-12, alternative schooling, and career-learning platforms
summary: Expanded the universe for virtual K-12, alternative schooling, and career-learning platforms using a two-lane funnel. Stride is the reference pure-play for full-service virtual K-12 and career learning. The underfollowed lane points to smaller public companies supplying adjacent literacy curriculum, school distribution, social-emotional/leadership curriculum, coaching, tutoring, and district-facing live-learning infrastructure. The key chokepoint hypothesis remains that defensibility may sit less in video-course technology and more in curriculum breadth, district/state relationships, support infrastructure, teacher/tutor networks, and measurable outcomes.
